title: Container Restart Loop
description: The report worker restarts every 40 seconds. Its last health check fails before exit.

nodes.text: The report worker restarts every 40 seconds. Its last health check fails before exit.

actions.label: Check host resources
actions.result: The Docker volume is 100% full; CPU and memory remain normal.

actions.label: Restart container
actions.result: It starts once, cannot write its checkpoint, and enters the restart loop again.

nodes.text: The incident continues. Temporary relief did not address the underlying cause.
observations: It starts once, cannot write its checkpoint, and enters the restart loop again.
The team still needs a diagnosis.

actions.label: Check host resources
actions.result: The Docker volume is 100% full; CPU and memory remain normal.

nodes.text: The first evidence narrows the fault domain.
observations: The Docker volume is 100% full; CPU and memory remain normal.

actions.label: Inspect disk usage
actions.result: A verbose debug log occupies 91 GB and continues growing.

actions.label: Rotate logs and cap retention without verification
actions.result: The unverified change creates risk and the incident is escalated after the recovery window expires.

nodes.text: Evidence now supports a specific root cause.
observations: A verbose debug log occupies 91 GB and continues growing.

actions.label: Rotate logs and cap retention
actions.result: Space is recovered, retention is enforced, and the worker stays healthy.

nodes.text: Service indicators remain healthy through the observation window.
observations: Space is recovered, retention is enforced, and the worker stays healthy.

nodes.text: The response window closes with customer impact unresolved.
observations: The incident is handed to the next response team.

rootCause: A runaway debug log filled the container host disk, preventing the worker from writing checkpoints.

review.explanation: A runaway debug log filled the container host disk, preventing the worker from writing checkpoints.
learningNotes: Use evidence to narrow the fault domain before changing production.
Temporary symptom relief is not the same as removing a root cause.
